items.q: Silver. I got the silver one. Benny Goodman got the gold.

ctx.x: I got -- Well, I have three Esquire awards when they were giving them out.
Silver. I got the silver one. Benny Goodman got the gold. And that was for three years straight. So that was nice, too.
